svg.aria-label: Diagram: a company at the center connected to six ecosystem groups, technology partners, service and solution partners, affiliate and referral partners, influencers and content creators, customer advocates and ambassadors, and sponsored events, with the ties between adjacent groups drawn as the dominant hexagonal network, the company as one subordinate node within it, and a single continuous connective frame for community running through every group equally. Source: conversation with Andy Claremont, Head of Ecosystem and Community, Glide.
svg.text: An ecosystem is a network, not a channel list
Six groups radiate out from the company: the real shift is treating the ties
between them as the map, not just the spokes to the center.
COMMUNITY: CONNECTIVE LAYER, NOT A SEVENTH GROUP
direct: every group also touches the company
peer: illustrative ties between groups, not verified for any single company
community: the connective layer running through every group
Source: conversation with Andy Claremont, Head of Ecosystem & Community, Glide: Communitygeeks Field Note, Aug 2026.
